Author: ncapozzo3-lgtm <n.capozzo3@gmail.com>
Date:   Tue Nov 17 10:14:49 2026 -0500

    feat(gateway): track IP + usage on the forwarded rc_ak_live_ key path (#13)
    
    #12 only logged usage on the locally-minted rc_sk_live_ path. Production
    uses Postgres-backed rc_ak_live_ keys, which hit handleGatewayApiKeyForward
    and return before recordOpenApiKeyUsage, so no real traffic was tracked.
    
    Append a usage event on the forward path too (captures status, since it
    runs post-upstream), keyed by a non-reversible sha256 of the gateway key
    (never the raw key). Now every /v1/chat call is tracked by IP regardless
    of key type. Best-effort; never affects the proxied response.
    
    Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
